title: Forge Rule v1
description: Structural schema for a ForgeRule definition — the normative shape of a rule entry in the Forge Rule Registry. This schema does NOT define an executable condition language: 'condition' is a human-readable description of the check, not code the compiler evaluates. See docs/bible/06-forge/092-rule-anatomy.md for the full field-by-field rationale and docs/bible/06-forge/109-rule-registry.md for how rules are aggregated into a registry.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier, e.g. JM-BAND-001 or FORGE-SYS-001. Never renamed once published (FORGE-GOV-001).

version.description: Rule semantic version, independent of JDL/product/compiler/geometry versions — see docs/bible/06-forge/108-rule-versioning.md.

blockingScope.description: One rule may block more than one scope (e.g. GENERATION and, transitively, ALL_EXPORTS). NONE must be the sole element when present.

condition.description: Human-readable description of the check performed, optionally naming the exact function that implements it (e.g. 'band.width < 1.5mm, see validation/engine.py::_band_rules'). Never an executable expression — no condition DSL exists in v1 (see docs/bible/06-forge/092-rule-anatomy.md).

targetFields.description: Canonical JDL field paths this rule reads, e.g. ['band.width'].

dependencies.description: ruleIds that must be evaluated (and not fatally blocking) before this rule can run meaningfully. See docs/bible/06-forge/100-rule-dependencies-and-ordering.md.

evaluationContext.description: What ForgeEvaluationContext data this rule needs beyond the raw document.

resultCode.description: Usually identical to ruleId; kept distinct only for rules that can emit more than one diagnostic shape.

autoFixCapability.description: See docs/bible/06-forge/102-suggestions-and-auto-fix-contract.md. No rule in v1 has anything other than NONE or SUGGEST_ONLY — SAFE_NORMALIZATION is a defined-but-unused category.

applicableJewelryCategories.description: e.g. ['ring']. Empty/omitted means 'all currently supported categories'.

introducedIn.description: The rule version this ruleId first appeared at, e.g. '1.0.0'.

deprecatedIn.description: The rule version this ruleId was deprecated at, or null if still active.
